name: Maine Audubon Day Camps
description_short: Maine Audubon runs nature day camps at Gilsland Farm Audubon Center in Falmouth (Greater Portland) and Fields Pond Audubon Center in Holden (Greater Bangor). There are summer programs for preschoolers through rising 6th graders, plus February and April vacation camps.
refund_policy_summary: Summer camp: full refund if Maine Audubon cancels. If the family cancels after June 1, there is no refund. Cancellations before June 1 are refunded minus a $30 processing fee per registration. COVID-related cancellations are refunded minus $30. Vacation camp: no refund within 14 days of the start. Earlier cancellations are refunded minus a $30 fee.

warnings: The 2027 summer details aren't out yet. Every 2027 summer program says 'More information coming January 2027', and the vacation camps say 'More information coming November 2026'. There are no 2027 dates, prices or sessions to record.
The schedule PDF and the 'What's new' links on the page are for Summer 2026, which is over.
The camp runs at two sites: Gilsland Farm in Falmouth and Fields Pond Audubon Center in Holden. The address recorded is Gilsland Farm, which is also the Maine Audubon headquarters address.
The summer refund policy gives two different years. It says no refunds after June 1, 2027, but refunds before June 1, 2026. Probably a typo; check with the camp.

Ages don't match across the page. One section says the summer camps are for 'children ages 3-9', but Fields Pond Raptors is for rising 4th-6th graders, who are likely older than 9. So the maximum age was left blank.

Summer program names: Gilsland Farm has Sprouts (ages 3-5), Saplings (ages 4-5) and Discovery Kids (K-3). Fields Pond has Songbirds (rising 1st-3rd) and Raptors (rising 4th-6th). Gilsland Farm uses a registration lottery.
